newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens on dollar, firms vs pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens on dollar, firms vs pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against the dollar but strengthened versus the pound on Friday, reflecting international trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean rate of 19.9865 to the dollar from 19.9535 on Thursday, and at 33.2945 to the pound from 33.4335 on Thursday.
Forex dealers said the weaker rupee reflected overnight strengthening of the dollar in international markets.

"Commercial banks are presently long in their foreign exchange reserves as demand is low at this period of year and also because of earnings from the peak season in the tourism sector," one dealer said.
The dealer added that the long positions in commercial banks were also the result of regular central bank sales of dollars during interventions over the past weeks.
